17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans ~ 5351-57 West Addison Street / 5551-57 North
Long Avenue, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: B2-2 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District
Lot Area: Approximately 11,812.98 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to redevelop the subject property with a new
three-story residential building containing nine (9) dwelling units. The
proposed building will measure 33 ft.-6.38 in. in height and will be
supported by ten (10) off-street parking spaces at the rear. Pursuant to Sec.
17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation and
pursuant to Secs. 17-13-1101-D and 17-13-1101-B of the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to increase the off-street parking space
requirement from nine (9) parking spaces to ten (10) parking spaces,
increase the front setback (along West Addison Street) from the required 9
ft-9.5 in. to 15 ft., increase the east side setback from 9 ft.-4.81 in. to 9 ft.-6
in. (west side setback to remain at 7 ft.-6.25 in.), and is seeking all relief
necessary, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans.

(A) The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 13,667.34 square feet (1.16 FAR)

(B) _ The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 1,312.55 square feet per D.U.
(9 residential units)

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 10 parking spaces

*Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1101-D, the Applicant is seeking to increase the required
number of off-street parking spaces from 5 parking spaces to 10 parking spaces.

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback (along West Addison Street): 15 feet
b. Side Setbacks:
East Side: 9 feet-6 inches
West Side: 7 feet-6.25 inches
c. Rear Setback: 41 feet

*Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1101-B, the Applicant is seeking to increase the front
setback (along West Addison Street) from the required 9 ft-9.5 in. to 15 ft., increase
the east side setback from 9 ft.-4.81 in. to 9 ft.-6 in. (west side setback to remain at
7 ft.-6.25 in.). .

(E) Building Height: 33 feet-6.38 inches
